messages.subject: Error when using getprofile() function
parts:
I get the following error message when using the getprofile() function from the funqtl package.

Error in lastout[[ij]][lst, ] : subscript out of bounds

This function works great for most of the data I have pushed through it, but I recently came across this error on one dataset and I'm not sure what I'm doing wrong.

I've attached the data and the function calls I've made. One of them runs very smoothly the other one throws the error message. 

My initial thought is that maybe the second model is inappropriately large for this function?
